verdict.rationale: Perplexity's Agent API runs the whole search-extract-synthesize flow in one API. Built-in Perplexity-hosted tools cover web search and URL fetch, and Perplexity runs them and returns results inline. Pro Search adds automated multi-step reasoning that performs multiple web searches and fetches URL content, and responses come back as cited, synthesized answers or structured JSON. The Search API also offers extracted content for raw pipelines. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-step research quality and extraction depth.
